title: You Got One

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Well now, how is it out there amongst the waves? Have you caught any fish yet or will you be forced to starve?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well now, how is it out there amongst the waves? Have you caught any fish yet or will you be forced to starve?

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Ah, it appears you do. Congratulations! You are on your way to being the greatest fisherman in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, it appears you do. Congratulations! You are on your way to being the greatest fisherman in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Of course. Be sure to let me know if you wanna make some extra Lims with that skill of yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. Be sure to let me know if you wanna make some extra Lims with that skill of yours.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Ah, who really knows what is going on with the Localized Unity Zone. On the one hand, I feel more unified... unified against CorpSec. Ha!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, who really knows what is going on with the Localized Unity Zone. On the one hand, I feel more unified... unified against CorpSec. Ha!

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Many ways, but the quickest? Get yourself into the underground fish market.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Many ways, but the quickest? Get yourself into the underground fish market.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: The underground fish market is a thing and a thing does what a thing does and is what a thing is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The underground fish market is a thing and a thing does what a thing does and is what a thing is.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: You must meet the quota. Find the fish. Catch the fish. Put the fish in the market.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must meet the quota. Find the fish. Catch the fish. Put the fish in the market.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Sail the Gridless Sea and stand on the land's edge. Learn the waters, know the waters, and bring the fish from them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sail the Gridless Sea and stand on the land's edge. Learn the waters, know the waters, and bring the fish from them.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Perhaps something small and achievable so you don't wander into turbulent waters haunted by only the mooring ghosts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps something small and achievable so you don't wander into turbulent waters haunted by only the mooring ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Ok, I tell you what- a market order just came through last night for a pair of burbot, stickleback, and 3 pike... Catch them, bring them back, and we will get you into that market.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, I tell you what- a market order just came through last night for a pair of burbot, stickleback, and 3 pike... Catch them, bring them back, and we will get you into that market.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Now, IF I told you that, how would you prove your skills? Finding them is only half the challenge. Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now, IF I told you that, how would you prove your skills? Finding them is only half the challenge. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Well.. CorpSec unified against us. Like they have an extra pair of eyes on this part of town.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well.. CorpSec unified against us. Like they have an extra pair of eyes on this part of town.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think about the LUZ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks. Appreciate your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. Appreciate your help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And how do I make money fishing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And how do I make money fishing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And how do I make money fishing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And how do I make money fishing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds very illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds very illegal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right... How do I get in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... How do I get in?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right... How do I get in?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right... How do I get in?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I start?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So just ANY fish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So just ANY fish?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, don't want that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, don't want that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where should I fish for them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where should I fish for them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where should I fish for them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where should I fish for them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you be a bit more SPECIFIC?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you be a bit more SPECIFIC?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you be a bit more SPECIFIC?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you be a bit more SPECIFIC?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... small fish it is!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... small fish it is!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Windy, but I got some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Windy, but I got some.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And on the other hand?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And on the other hand?
